content.text: Summary: Read T-2009, listed pods in `pricing` (both pricing-engine pods in CrashLoopBackOff on the unchanged April image), pulled logs showing a Go panic while compiling rule BF-2026-STACKED fetched from rules-admin revision 8841, and confirmed via docs that CrashLoopBackOff here is just Kubernetes' normal backoff around an application panic. Resolved the ticket with the cause (bad/new rule triggers a latent bounds bug in pricing-engine 4.11.3 at startup), the evidence, and the fix: revert rule BF-2026-STACKED / roll rules-admin back before revision 8841, then patch the TierTable.Lookup bounds check as a follow-up. No cluster changes needed.
